scope: FD28 reusable rich-text component and bounded formatting/image improvements; retain existing editor and HTML. No workflow changes or backend runtime migration.

source.verified: Official text: rich-field toolbar, 5 MB single image, 10 images, text-only summaries/exports.
source.visualLimit: Official embedded images failed to load (403/timeout). Product visual parity not established.

verified: One editing implementation; form wrapper only selects policy and local file storage.
Core has no feature, repository, Pinia, route or FormField imports.
Independent tests mount two editors without Pinia/router/indexedDB; input and dialog IDs stay independent.
Upload and optional blob resolution supplied through an adapter; failed uploads can retry with selected files.
Focused local input echoes retain DOM; explicit external replacements reset the editor.
Pending upload cannot write after content replacement, readonly or unmount; late blob reads allocate no URLs after unmount.
Body images store existing file-repository references; blob URLs are omitted from saved HTML and released.
Description still uses compact tools and inline images with original 1 MB boundary.
Colors and their CSS moved to common components; old feature implementations removed.

behavior: Headings, lists, strike, background colors, indent/outdent, clear formatting, undo/redo.
Image presets retained; alignment, selected-image deletion and enlarged viewing added.
Rich images in readonly content can be viewed without editing tools.
Existing inline images and local file IDs remain readable; removing an image does not purge shared stored files.

verified: Saved 1.48 MiB image to a native draft, reloaded and submitted the same entry ID.
Heading, two ordered items, strikethrough, highlight and indent persisted.
Centered image, removed it, then native Undo restored image and alignment while surrounding text remained.
Edited same record; cold refresh retains stable image ID, 25% width, centering and 720px natural image width.
Readonly detail loads image and opens image viewer; Escape closes viewer and retains detail.
390x844 full toolbar wraps; image menu rect left62/right382/bottom700 is inside viewport.
Escape closes image menu alone and keeps edit dialog open.
browser.console: Transient Vite reload errors occurred during file moves at 14:26. Subsequent successful cold reload and UI operation after 14:33 had no newer warning/error in captured logs.

checks.backend: No runtime changes. Build includes TypeScript compilation; runtime tests not rerun.

limits: FD28 remains partial: custom/data-link defaults, 30k HTML and per-form rich-field-count constraints, drag resizing, full permission combinations and exact visual reference.
Full rich PDF image output and complete server-backed rich-text storage are not verified by this batch.
Storage adapters are an interface, not evidence of a real external upload integration.
Cross-browser native editing behavior outside the current embedded Chromium browser is not established.
